label: Diagram 2
caption: Diagram 2 Size and proportion of non-residential buildings and annexes
description: Diagram 2, 'Size and proportion of non-residential buildings and annexes', notes 'See paras 2C4b and 2C4c' and shows line-drawn blocks. Part a, 'Non-residential buildings', has two. Left, 'Flat roof buildings': a block with a window on the left face and a door on the front face, with the right side dimensioned '3.0m max' and 'H'. Right, 'Pitched roof buildings': a block with a sloped roof, 'Maximum roof slope 40°'; right side '3.0m max', '3.6m max', 'H max', with a small vertical double-line symbol between the eave and the ridge. Part b, 'Annexes', has three blocks each joined to an outline 'Residential building'. First, 'Flat roof annexes': the 'Annexe' marked '3.0m max' and 'H'. Second, 'Pitched roof annexes (type 1)': the 'Annexe' with 'Maximum roof slope 40°', left side '3.5m max', '3.0m max', 'H', right side '4.5m max', 'H'. Third, 'Pitched roof annexes (type 2)': the 'Annexe' with 'Maximum roof slope 40°', left side '3.0m max', 'H', right side '3.5m max', '4.5m max', 'H'. A boxed note reads: 'Height H should be measured from top of the foundation or from the underside of the floor slab where this provides effective lateral restraint.'
